plot-title: Margin at each cell against the answer margin
plot-caption: Pearson r over 591 images between the yes-minus-no margin of a read and the same margin in the model output. Each row is a token of the prompt after the image, and each column is a layer. The first columns of each pair use the J++ lens, and the others use the plain logit lens. The margin at the last tokens is near the answer by construction.
